title: Grateful Dead Live at Palace Theater on 1972-09-24

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 9/24/72 Palace Theater show shines with a monster Dark Star → China Cat → Rider sequence, captured on a solid soundboard recording despite some edits.
ai_review.review: The Waterbury performance is praised for its relentless intensity and an unforgettable 45‑minute Dark Star > Jam > China Cat > I Know You Rider stretch that defines the night. The soundboard source is generally clear and well‑balanced, though listeners note occasional edits, speed quirks and brief gaps. Overall the music outweighs the technical hiccups, making this a standout entry from the legendary September ’72 run.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show and sound highly (4‑5 stars); the performance is consistently described as high energy with standout Dark Star, while recording issues are noted but not fatal, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp overall sound with some editing artifacts, speed variations and a few cuts (e.g., missing 48 sec in Playing In The Band). Despite these quirks the SBD is the best‑sounding source available.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Jam > China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Greatest Story Ever Told > Bertha > Promised Land
show_quality.setlist_flow: Two‑set show with a high‑intensity first set and a second set that builds into the epic Dark Star jam, maintaining strong momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s lead work drives the Dark Star and other jams; his guitar tone is noted as solid throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass is highlighted as a “takeover” during the long Dark Star, providing a powerful low‑end foundation.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir delivers strong rhythm and vocal contributions, notably launching "El Paso" and anchoring the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux receives praise for his keyboard work, especially on the jam sections; reviewers suggest checking his interplay with Phil.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum segment is singled out as a highlight within the Dark Star transition, adding to the night’s intensity.
